rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0001
rows.name:
Your Majesty! How was
the Iiran capital?

rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0002
rows.name:
What? It was every bit as prosperous
as our Superbian Empire?

rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0003
rows.name:
How wonderful... I must inspect it
as special envoy. I have long been
interested in Iiran culture...

rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0004
rows.name:
I can't go because I'm the special
envoy to Gula? H-Yuugo-sama!
Th-that is certainly true, but...!

rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0005
rows.name:
B-but still! I've long been interested
in Iira's architecture and food...
B-but to disobey His Majesty...!

rows.label: tlk70000074_03_msg0006
rows.name:
Huh? Y-you were joking? Y-Your
Majesty... You just took ten years off
my life...
